methods.startup: Five fresh processes per version/entry/command; alternating baseline,current,current,baseline,baseline,current,current,baseline,baseline,current. Same source override and extra source read in both modes. Empty PATH; same initialized empty project; warm filesystem; uncontrolled desktop activity. No task benchmark/test/build/package workload overlap.
methods.workloads: Three baseline batches before production edits, followed by three current batches. Serial files/cases, fresh projects. Same override in both modes and all spawned CLI children. Summed top-level test-body time excludes file/process loading. Fixed batch order is not randomized/interleaved; ranges describe local variation rather than statistical confidence. No other task test/build/package workload overlap.
methods.functional: Complete serial suite and installed-artifact verifier run concurrently after accepted measurements. Their durations are functional evidence, excluded from performance comparisons. No comparable full-suite baseline was taken in this iteration.
methods.coverage: CLI group consolidates 3 cases into 2 while preserving assertions; SHACL file gains a public attribution case (29 to 30); design group consolidates 2 into 1. New loader regressions are included by the full default suite, outside the selected CLI timing pattern.
